versions.text: See AMC.1787 (a) (a) The UCS must include an automatic diagnostic and monitoring capability for the status of the UAV System and provide to the UAV crew appropriate warning indication. (b) Guidance for corrective actions shall be provided either automatically or in the UAV System Flight Manual.

See AMC.U1787 (a) (a) The UCS must include an automatic diagnostic and monitoring capability for the status of the UA and provide to the UAS crew appropriate warning indication. (b) Warnings, Cautions and advisories shall be provided in an organized, prioritized system, and the presentation of high priority information shall not be masked by the presence of older lower priority information. (c) Guidance for corrective actions shall be provided either automatically or in the UAS Flight Manual.
